new_value: Decided 2026-11-27. The prefix is the tracker's identity in sync (prefix_mismatch), so a rename needs a timestamped config merge and a new way to tell a rename from a different tracker: an ADR and rework, not a command. IDs never change (ADR-0017), so a rename would only affect new issues, and the prompting case (imported SR-014 beside new sr-xxx) is cosmetic; import keeps old IDs as they are. Not to be reconsidered without doing that underlying rework; the lowercase-prefix rule is the cheaper thing to revisit if the mixed look ever matters.
